Over the span of five decades, Ting created a vibrant body of work that investigated movement in all forms: from the movement of the hand marking the surface of a canvas to the movement of bodies in space; from movements that organized musical compositions to the movement across oceans and borders that defined her lived experiences as an Asian American immigrant.
